verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a programmable surface for this product. The Stripe MCP server exposes tools for agents to call the Stripe API, and sandboxes provision working API keys with no account registration. Bridge's API docs describe programmatic on-ramps, off-ramps and crypto-to-crypto flows, with a sandbox and webhooks. Missing for 10: explicit API reference coverage of the crypto/stablecoin-specific endpoints (payments, payouts, financial accounts), a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (probed paths returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of driving the crypto features via API.
